text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle is hard at work training<n>for the Mile
Championship.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, she learns that her friend,<n>Silence Suzuka,
will be entering the<n>same race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka explains that she's on a<n>search to find the
"something" that<n>she's missing by challenging
herself<n>with various races.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the knowledge that she'll be<n>running against
her rival, Taiki<n>Shuttle's excitement is through the
roof. She gives our training sessions<n>her undivided
attention.
